hooks.name: Terraform fmt check
hooks.description: Run terraform fmt -check when a .tf or .tfvars file is saved; prints a warning if formatting is needed.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path',''))" 2>/dev/null)
DIR=$(dirname "$FILE")
if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  cd "$DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
  terraform fmt -check -diff "$FILE" 2>/dev/null \
    && echo "✓ terraform fmt OK: $FILE" \
    || echo "⚠ terraform fmt needed: run 'terraform fmt $FILE'"
fi
